claim: Across 30 controlled paired live runs using the same goal, models, dataset, and immutable contract per pair, the ungated fleet executed unsafe logistics outcomes in 28 runs; INVARIANT executed none. INVARIANT completed 12 runs with final integrity PASS and blocked the remaining 18 fail-closed.
limitations: The business environment is a deterministic logistics simulator, not an external production logistics system.
The corpus contains five scenario templates repeated six times.
Results demonstrate this runtime and corpus; they are not a universal agent-safety guarantee.
